A free tier covers 10,000 requests per gateway per month; paid billing starts January 1, 2027; and private networking remains in preview. By Steef-Jan Wiggers

items.title: Is Claude Obstructing Research? An Anthropic Employee Denies It and Acknowledges Overcaution
items.summary: After reports spread of unusually poor results in machine learning research using Claude, an Anthropic employee denied any intent to obstruct the work. He acknowledged a problem Anthropic calls overcaution, in which the AI makes up its own rules during long tasks and keeps following them.

items.title: Google Play Will Publish Individual App Developers' Phone Numbers and Addresses Worldwide — Apple Limits Disclosure to the EU
items.summary: Google Play will make individual app developers' phone numbers and addresses visible worldwide as part of its response to European consumer protection laws. Apple limits disclosure to the EU's 27 member states and accepts P.O. boxes.

items.title: DRAM Contract Prices Could Fall as Early as Q4 2027 in TrendForce's Two-Scenario Forecast
items.summary: Taiwanese market researcher TrendForce published base and bearish scenarios for DRAM contract prices in 2027 and 2028. In the base case, prices start falling across all product segments in Q1 2028. In the bearish case, prices could begin falling in Q4 2027.

items.title: Godot 4.8 Reaches Release Candidate Stage and Raises the C# Edition's Minimum to .NET 10
items.summary: The open-source game engine Godot published its first 4.8 release candidate on November 27 (UTC), locking in the new features ahead of the stable release. The C# edition now requires at least .NET 10.

items.title: Strata 0.2.23 Reaches 360 Tokens per Second on an RTX 5090 and Adds a Model for 12GB GPUs
items.summary: Version 0.2.23 of the local AI inference engine Strata uses DFlash 2 speculative decoding to reach 360 tokens per second in chat on an RTX 5090. The release also adds a model file for GPUs with 12GB of VRAM.

items.title: WinUI Image Downloads Can Stall for an Hour After a Connection Drops
items.summary: A missing receive timeout in Microsoft's WinUI can leave an image download stalled for up to an hour when the network connection drops. A proposed fix sets a 30-second receive timeout.

items.summary: A system built with NVIDIA's export-controlled Blackwell AI chips may be installed at a data center in Shanghai, China. A serial number in loan collateral filings reportedly matched a GB300 NVL72 rack made by Taiwan's GIGABYTE when checked against a public warranty database.

items.title: Android 17 on a PC With 4GB of RAM: CapivaOS Releases a LineageOS 24-Based ISO
items.summary: With Android-x86 dormant for more than five years and BlissOS temporarily suspending downloads, developer Mateus Seiboth has released a CapivaOS ISO on SourceForge, bringing the Android 17-based LineageOS 24.0 to PCs.

items.title: AMD Proposes a Linux Driver Fix for Overstated APU GPU Memory That Can Crash Local AI Apps
items.summary: AMD's Linux GPU driver overstated free and total GPU memory on some APUs. If vLLM or llama.cpp sizes a buffer using those figures, the process can run out of memory and be killed. Proposed patches align the reported values with what the OS can provide.

items.title: Chile Seeks an Apple Fine Above $80 Million and an Open iOS App Market: Apple Pushes Back
items.summary: Chile's competition authority says Apple monopolizes iOS app distribution and in-app sales of digital goods. It is asking a court for a fine of more than $80 million and remedies including sideloading and alternative payments. Apple says it will cooperate but disputes how the authority defines the market.
